answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluates the epoch polynomial to derive rate-limit proofs and nullifiers. A single permitted message remains unlinkable, but duplicate messages in the same scope expose distinct Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the private identity key, allowing the network to verify the violation and slash bonded collateral immediately. The epoch-bound rule makes a nebula of Sybil identities costly, while the reef of proofs and a marble-clear slashing condition make enforcement auditable.
